python: >=3.11; offline analysis uses only the standard library

architecture.schema.py: Model inputs separated from evaluation annotations
architecture.rendering.py: Chronological rendering with optional binary parent annotations
architecture.metrics.py: Versioned domain-neutral AP, ROC-AUC, PR curves and operating metrics
architecture.legacy.py: Read-only archived safety-sweep importer and metric verification
architecture.inference.py: Optional pinned native Kev backend with audit capture; GPU runtime is not installed by the analysis package
architecture.runner.py: Explicit LINK and matched SAFETY functions; no CLI rewriting or module-global patching

migration.cleanup: 39 legacy experimental scripts and launchers removed from working directories at user request. Data, reports, logs, run snapshots and third-party source/documentation remain preserved.
migration.historical_artifacts: Preserved in place; never imported as executable dependencies
migration.current_status: Offline core, chronological rendering, binary graphs, explicit LINK/SAFETY runner and pinned Kev backend extracted. Latest safety sweep has an offline reproduction adapter. Earlier model-specific scripts remain archived; native GPU adapter needs a separately authorized parity execution before scientific use.
next_steps: Validate extracted native backend on the pinned remote runtime before new experiments
Complete independently reviewed annotation and freeze the pilot specification
Port earlier result adapters only with recorded parity evidence
migration.acceptance: Same inputs produce identical rendered bytes and archived point metrics within 1e-12; intentional semantic changes receive a new version.

git: Local repository; no commits or pushes without explicit request
artifacts: Generated outputs excluded from Git; evidence manifests are tracked candidates
reports: JSON/JSONL only, in accordance with the existing project preference
